title: WorkflowArtifact
description: A workflow definition moved between environments: its name, its ordered steps and, when it has any, its data-store entries; nothing environment-bound (no id, owner, status, sharing or fork data). Every key of a step is always written (null, never omitted); the dataStore section is written only when there are entries and a file without it is valid. Rules a schema cannot state, enforced by the importer: stepOrder equals the step's 1-based position; each step's config, serialized, is at most 50000 characters; a data-store entry must satisfy the store's own rules (key of 1 to 100 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen and not only dots, a dataType of 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, a value of at most 524288 bytes compact, at most 100 distinct keys); documents nested deeper than 64 levels and object keys longer than 1000 characters are refused; duplicate keys are refused. String lengths count code points.
